Description: The engine's layers, bottom up, and the build: CMake makes one static library per layer from this table (Strata_<Name>, CMake/StrataLayers.cmake), linking exactly the built layers of its MayInclude. Every file under SourceRoot belongs to exactly one layer (Paths minus Exclude, globs relative to SourceRoot) and may include only files of its own layer and of the layers in MayInclude, which must be listed below it, and none of the third-party headers whose path starts with a prefix of its MayNotIncludeExternal. Tooling marks the layers games never contain (their libraries are excluded from all, linked through StrataTooling); Option names the CMake option that builds an optional layer. Architecture.Layering (StrataTests/src/Architecture/LayeringTests.cpp) enforces the includes and Architecture.Libraries the libraries; LayeringAllowlist.txt lists the known exceptions, each with the workstream that removes it, and holds exactly MaxAllowlistEntries lines (lower it when you remove one). Widen a MayInclude only for a proven downward dependency, with the reason in the layer's Notes; never to legalize a sideways or upward include

Layers.Name: Core
Layers.Notes: Platform services, logging, jobs, files, processes and math. The OS implementations of Core interfaces live in Platform/<OS>; the socket implementations belong to Network.

Layers.Name: Input
Layers.Notes: Events and the input state; Input reaches the window through InputWindow, which Window implements.

Layers.Name: App
Layers.Notes: The application shell: Application, layers, the EngineModule interface the modules implement (Application runs their hooks and names none of them), the window and its GLFW implementation. VulkanLoader belongs here, not to Renderer: it loads the system's Vulkan loader for the window system (GLFW must create surfaces through the same loader as the graphics device) and depends only on Core.

Layers.Name: Asset
Layers.Notes: Asset registry, loading, packs and built-in asset handles, without the importers (AssetPipeline). It knows no graphics API: GPU assets record their uploads into the AssetUploadContext the renderer provides (the IAssetGraphics engine service), so neither NVRHI nor Vulkan headers may be included here.

Layers.Name: Audio
Layers.Notes: App is a proven downward dependency: the Audio module implements its EngineModule (Core/EngineModule.h), the interface App defines for the services a program runs; App includes no Audio header.

Layers.Name: Animation
Layers.Notes: Skeletons, clips, animation controllers and the Animation scene system. The renderer never includes it: poses reach it through the scene service ISkinningPoses (Scene/SceneServices.h), and scripts reach animators through IAnimatorControl.

Layers.Name: World
Layers.Notes: World partition: the World asset, its grid, the streaming core and the World scene system. Physics, the renderer and scripting never include it: they reach a world's streaming through the scene services IWorldStreaming and IPhysicsCapacity.

Layers.Name: Project
Layers.Notes: App is a proven downward dependency: the Project module implements its EngineModule (Core/EngineModule.h), the interface App defines for the services a program runs; App includes no Project header.

Layers.Name: Runtime
Layers.Notes: Runs exported games: may include every layer a shipped game contains.

Layers.Name: Network
Layers.Notes: Sockets, JSON-RPC and editor sessions (tooling); includes the OS socket implementations.

Layers.Name: ImGui
Layers.Notes: Dear ImGui's layer and engine module (tooling: editors and tools; games have no ImGui).

Layers.Name: AssetPipeline
Layers.Notes: Importers, the texture cooker and its BC7 encoder, the editor's asset database, the dependency scanner and the pack writer (tooling, never in shipped games: games only read packs, so they link no compressor). Animation is a proven downward dependency: the glTF importer writes the stored forms of skeletons and clips, and the dependency scanner reads the clips an animation controller plays. World is one too: the dependency scanner reads the persistent scene and the cells of world documents.

Layers.Name: Engine
Layers.Notes: The composition root (Engine/BuiltinModules) and the entry point that calls it (Engine/EntryPoint.h, ApplicationLaunch.h). Both are part of every program, shipped games included, so they name only the modules a game contains: tools hand the asset pipeline in (ModuleRegistrationOptions::AssetPipeline), and programs list their engine modules (ApplicationSpecification::Modules), so the importers, the network and ImGui stay out of games.
